title: More Than Seeing: Vision as Scalable Anchors in Native Multimodal Pre-Training
abstract: arXiv:2610.19443v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Native multimodal pre-training trains a single model from scratch on text and multimodal data, enabling it to understand both language and visual inputs. However, how visual signals shape scaling behavior and support capabilities beyond visual understanding remains unclear. We investigate this question through controlled visual-content ablations across model sizes and training budgets. Specifically, we replace image embeddings with content-free padding token embeddings. Retaining visual content improves text prediction on image-text examples without materially changing the lowest text-only loss at a given compute budget, the optimal balance of model size and training data, or aggregate language scores. The relative multimodal loss benefit grows approximately as a power law of compute. To test benefits beyond understanding images, we evaluate spatial reasoning from text descriptions alone. translated_title: 超越视觉：视觉作为原生多模态预训练中的可扩展锚点
translated_abstract: 原生多模态预训练是指从零开始在文本和多模态数据上训练单一模型，使其能够理解语言和视觉输入。然而，视觉信号如何塑造扩展行为并支持超越视觉理解的能力，目前仍不清楚。我们通过在不同模型规模和训练预算下进行受控的视觉内容消融实验来研究这一问题。具体而言，我们用无内容的填充词元嵌入替换图像嵌入。结果表明，保留视觉内容可以提升图文样例上的文本预测能力，而不会实质性改变给定计算预算下最低的纯文本损失、模型规模与训练数据的最优平衡，或整体语言得分。相对的多模态损失收益大致随计算量呈幂律增长。为测试超越图像理解本身的收益，我们仅基于文本描述评估空间推理能力，两种条件均随模型和数据规模的扩大而改善。
tldr: 该研究通过受控消融实验发现，在原生多模态预训练中保留视觉内容能在不损害纯文本性能的前提下提升图文样例上的文本预测，多模态收益随计算量呈幂律增长，且视觉信号还可作为锚点提升纯文本空间推理等超越视觉理解的能力。
en_tdlr: Controlled visual-content ablations in native multimodal pre-training reveal that retaining visual content improves text prediction on image-text examples without degrading text-only performance, with multimodal benefits scaling as a power law of compute and extending to text-only spatial reasoning.
